The '''Assembly Director Droid DX-9''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] that was used to oversee the assembly line of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Upgraded versions included the [[Director Droid DX-10]] and the [[Prototype Director Droid DX-11]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
